title: The Console has one to-do page: CRM Tasks folds into Work

source.ref: Plans and calendar clarity audit 2026-11-25 (project thread: Audit the project and calendar system; doc https://claude.ai/artifact/GUTHmChGkqaEmPSRUdzJHz)

detail:
FOUND 2026-11-25 in production: crm_tasks holds 29 rows and every one is a Plan to-do (plan_id set); zero are CRM call-backs. /admin/crm/tasks lists every Frequency-Space crm_tasks row under 'Your follow-up list', so it shows the same to-dos as /admin/work under a different name and description. Fix: /admin/crm/tasks redirects to /admin/work, the crm-tasks row leaves lib/nav/studio.ts, and a call-back made from a contact is a to-do that lands in Work.

DONE 2026-11-25: /admin/crm/tasks redirects to /admin/work; the crm-tasks leaf left lib/nav/studio.ts (STUDIO_LEAVES and the CRM Engine row); task actions revalidate /admin/work. The contact follow-up button still writes a crm_tasks row, which Work lists under the root Space. TasksWorkspace stays on disk for the admin-selection-state probe and can go in a later sweep.

verify.note: Passes while the old page redirects and the menu has no CRM Tasks row.
